messages:
Rae: FYI p99 spike on /v1/generate at 09:10 UTC. p50/p95 steady, p99 up ~4x for ~7m.
Omar: Any evidence model shifted?
Rae: Model_infer flat in traces. Sampled spans point to routing + outbound-proxy decode.
Kali: We only show total + model in console. We should surface per-stage p50/p95/p99 (ingress,routing,proxy_decode,infer,total) with a coverage badge.
Omar: Caveat: computing p99 from independently sampled spans misleads. Proposal: agent emits a compact per-request map on completion {ingress_ms,routing_ms,decode_ms,infer_ms,total_ms,sample_origin,rollout_id}. Server computes quantiles per-field.
Kali: Fallback: if map absent, perform span-join and mark UI as "partial coverage". Add rollout-weight overlay to help correlate.
Rae: Ops: add a short-term dashboard annotation when rollout weight changes >10% near p99 jumps. telemetry-bot: created task TELE-2210.
Omar: I'll prototype a /internal/telemetry/stage-quantiles endpoint that returns rows=stages cols=p50/p95/p99 + coverage flag.
Kali: RFC for the agent change and UI spec by EOD Friday. If maps are <80% coverage, console should default to total-only but show the badge.
Rae: Good plan. If anyone sees similar p99 patterns, ping here with rollout timeline and a quick span sample.
